data.one_liner: Popular data preprocessing algorithms for machine learning in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides data preprocessing algorithms like one-hot encoding, label encoding, numerical normalization, and standardization for machine learning workflows. It uses DataFrame structures to manipulate tabular datasets before model training.
use_when: You are building machine learning pipelines in Dart and need to encode categorical features.
You need to normalize or standardize numerical datasets prior to training models.
avoid_when: You are working on non-ML application tasks such as standard CRUD or UI state management.
You need heavy deep learning frameworks that handle full tensor operations.
strengths: Provides a coherent Pipeline entity to chain multiple preprocessing steps.
Supports common preprocessing algorithms like one-hot encoding, label encoding, normalization, and standardization.
weaknesses: Requires manual data preparation and DataFrame packaging.
Limited to the algorithms implemented within the package.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding ml_dataframe as a dependency alongside ml_preprocessing.
